title: AfriStereo: A Culturally Grounded Dataset for Evaluating Stereotypical Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Bias Preference Ratios (BPR) by comparing model log probabilities for structurally identical sentence frames to measure systematic preferences for gender stereotypes over antistereotypes using the Stereotype-Antistereotype (S-AS) paradigm.
